content: Learning Competency EN7LIT-I-1: Analyze literary texts as expressions of individual or communal values within. Objectives: 1. Explain and share a critical insight on the feelings evoked from a reading material. 2. Read and define words related to the text, and deduce meaning of words. 3. Determine and differentiate the structure and elements of a poem. 4. Identify and evaluate the structural, biographical, historical, and sociocultural context of a poem. Content: Poetry: Descriptions and Imagery. Integration: Environmental awareness and preservation; SDG 13 and SDG 15. Day 1: Group activity on strengths and weaknesses from last year's English class; lesson purpose via 'Knowing Your Feelings Through Music' with the song 'Ako Ay Pilipino'; unlocking vocabulary through 'Think and Pick!' word puzzle; explicitation via 'Agree or Disagree' statements on literary elements. Day 2-3: Worked example 'Describing and Reading' using a beach image; reading 'Song' by NVM Gonzales with discussion questions; descriptive words and power of words; lesson activity 'Fulfill Me, Point It Out! Find My Form, Color Me' using 'For the Young Yearning a Song of Green' by Arnold Molina Azurin with guide questions on character, characterization, conflict, plot, rhyme, tone, pattern, diction, figures of speech, point of view, and sequencing. Day 4: Generalizations through exit slip 3-2-1 and reflection on learning; formative assessment using the poem to pick out text evidence and context (biographical, historical, sociocultural) with reasons.
subject: English
